markdown.markdown: ::: {layout="[100,50]"} ::: {#about layout-ncol=1} I am an Assistant Professor of Statistics (and data science) at [Cornell College](https://www.cornellcollege.edu/) - a small undergraduate liberal arts college. I received my PhD in Statistics and Analytics at Central Michigan University. During my PhD I also studied mathematics and statistics education. My dissertation work involved creating a new lack of fit test for linear regression models.
